adjudication.rationale: In `BookingListItem.tsx`, the new dropdown action `{ id: "add_members", label: t("additional_guests") }` is always appended to `actions` and simply opens `AddGuestsDialog` with no permission gating. On submit, the dialog calls `trpc.viewer.bookings.addGuests`. The server handler `addGuestsHandler` explicitly throws `FORBIDDEN` unless the user is the organizer (`booking.userId === user.id`), an existing attendee (`booking.attendees.find(...)`), or a team admin/owner (`isTeamAdminOrOwner`). Therefore, for any user who can see the booking item but does not meet those conditions, the UI presents an action that will deterministically fail and show an error toast. This is a real behavior mismatch introduced by the diff.
